title: Arrival
creator: Denis Villeneuve
summary: A linguist is brought in to communicate with alien visitors. The film is really about time, grief, and what it means to choose.
personalNote: The twist recontextualises everything, but unlike most films with twists, the rewatch is better than the first viewing. It becomes a film about accepting loss rather than escaping it. Amy Adams carries the whole thing with barely any dialogue. Villeneuve at his most precise.
